details.limitation: Static inventory reconciled through stage 3; active routes are additionally verified by runtime tests. Generators, GUI, lifecycle and exact CAD still retain Python.

native_layout.native: panel transforms, local/world bounds, irregular footprints, movement, rotation, full magnet/collision/contact loops
native_layout.batch_boundary: one scene request per layout operation; no per-comparison JSON calls
native_layout.retained_python: one accessory geometry extraction, immutable project projection, linked worktop lifecycle and exact CAD validation; worktop solver now C++

native_workspace_geometry.python_numeric_compatibility: original mixed integer/float winding retained once at adapter boundary
native_workspace_geometry.native: all intersection tests; native layout uses compensated winding directly

native_worktop.native: distance, polygon offset/union, complete height/overlap/connectivity/contour geometry solver
native_worktop.batch_boundary: one ordered body extraction and one native solver call; no per-edge Python callbacks
native_worktop.retained_python: body/configuration extraction; Part creation, linked IDs/signatures/status lifecycle, exact CAD preflight
native_worktop.compatibility: original Python numeric winding and exact binary-to-decimal ties-to-even round
